title: Client Runway — Weekly Spotlight 2028-10-18
meeting_objectives: Surface top customer integration blockers and estimate runway to GA
Agree owners & dates for remaining pre-prod work
Confirm burst/capacity needs for next two weeks
Identify escalations that require infra or security involvement
summary: Focused sync on three active customers in the onramp pipeline. Main themes: (1) network/SSO security gating for AuroraPay, (2) quantization/regression work for BluePeak Analytics' private pilot, (3) latency spikes under batch ingest for CardinalLabs. We validated tentative dates for final canary windows and enumerated immediate actions to unblock each customer.
meeting_notes: Quick status round: AuroraPay (60%), BluePeak Analytics (pilot staging), CardinalLabs (hosted integration, early prod).

AuroraPay: Security questionnaire outstanding (InfoSec). Anika expects responses from their legal on 10/20; our InfoSec to finish review by 10/22. SSO metadata exchange delayed until peering is provisioned.

BluePeak: Private deployment pilot hit a regression with quantized kernel on A100 drivers (KV cache pointer mismatch). Marina reproduced locally; workaround is to deploy non-quantized variant to the pilot cluster for the canary window. Engineering to root-cause; potential kernel pinning if regression persists.

CardinalLabs: During bulk catalog ingest (avg 45k tokens/min) p90 latency rose above 600ms. Jake (SRE) suspects batch coalescing thresholds; temporary mitigation: reduce max batch size and enable prefix caching for repeated catalogue prefixes. Cost delta estimated ~+18% for the next month if continued.

Capacity: We have three reserved slots in the dedicated pool. Proposal to allocate 1 slot for AuroraPay stress tests (10/25), 1 for BluePeak pilot canary (10/28), 1 as spare for emergency failover. If both tests run concurrently, request burst capacity from infra (estimate 2x GPUs for 4 hours).

Security: Private deployment checklist needs customer-signed network diagram + peering CIDR confirmation before we can schedule peering. Action: Solutions eng to provide runbook template by EOD 10/19.
Deployment cadence: Recommend short canary (2 hours) + health checks for model regressions using the existing eval set. If eval regressions > 2%, pause and escalate to Research.
Customer communications: Product to send a one-paragraph runbook summary to CardinalLabs explaining temporary latency mitigation and expected cost impact so they approve the tradeoff.
Cross-team asks: Infra to hold a 30-min kernel regression sync with Marina and release engineering tomorrow 10/19 10:00am PT.
Follow-ups: Confirm SSO metadata exchange time with AuroraPay; BluePeak to confirm whether they can accept non-quantized canary by 10/25 morning.
customers: AuroraPay — Status: onboarding 60%. Blockers: InfoSec questionnaire, network peering. Owner: Ethan Li. Key tickets: SE-7126. Next milestone: peering + SSO metadata exchange (target 10/22).

BluePeak Analytics — Status: private pilot staging. Blockers: quantized kernel regression on A100; workaround accepted (non-quantized canary). Owner: Marina Gomez. Key tickets: PRO-198. Next milestone: pilot canary (target 10/28).

CardinalLabs — Status: hosted integration in early prod. Blockers: batch latency spikes during high-throughput ingest. Owner: Tomás Rivera. Key tickets: SE-7099. Next milestone: temporary mitigation + customer comms (target 10/20).
action_items: Ethan Li: Coordinate InfoSec questionnaire closure with AuroraPay and share answers in Confluence (due 2028-10-22).
Marina Gomez: Run kernel regression triage, capture repro steps, and schedule infra sync (due 2028-10-19).
Tomás Rivera: Implement prefix caching and adjust batch thresholds in staging, run ingest sim, report latency and cost delta (due 2028-10-20).
Jacob Kim (SRE): Reserve burst GPUs with infra for dual tests on 2028-10-25/10-28 and confirm cost estimate (due 2028-10-21).
Asha Patel: Draft runbook template for peering + SSO exchange and post to Confluence (due 2028-10-19).
Priya Nair: Send one-paragraph customer note to CardinalLabs explaining mitigation and expected cost impact (due 2028-10-20).
risks: Security gating: If AuroraPay legal delays > 10 days, the customer GA window slips and we may need to negotiate a staged rollout.
Kernel regression: If quantization regression requires a driver rollback, private pilots could be delayed by 2+ weeks unless we can provide a non-quantized fallback path.
Capacity contention: Two concurrent canaries without burst approval could cause noisy neighbors on the dedicated pool and affect SLAs for existing tenants.
Cost overruns: CardinalLabs mitigation increases per-token cost ~18%; customer may push back and request further optimization before approving sustained use.
capacity_plan: Reserved pool: 3 slots currently tagged for SE pilots. Proposal: allocate per above and request a burst reservation (2 GPUs for up to 4 hours) for overlapping windows.
Autoscaling policy: temporarily loosen scale-down to avoid teardown during canary warm-up; restore defaults after canary completes.
Monitoring: Add a short-lived dashboard for each canary showing p50/p90 latency, tokens/sec, mem-util, and KV cache hit rate. Owner: Observability (Jake).
decisions: Use non-quantized build for BluePeak canary to minimize risk of pilot delay (decision made 2028-10-18).
Approve temporary prefix-caching and reduced batch size for CardinalLabs while SRE measures cost impact (decision made 2028-10-18).
notes_to_self: Keep the runbook short and prescriptive — customers won't read >2 pages. Include exact commands for peering checks and a checklist for SSO metadata fields.
Track kernel regression rollbacks separately so we can communicate driver pinning risk to Legal/Support early.
Log customer approval emails into the Confluence page to avoid recirculation during audits.
